assertions.title: Single-node graph renders without edges
test_names: graph with no dependencies renders no edges
assertions.notes: dependency-edge-styling.spec.ts:433 mocks two issues with no dependencies, asserts node count = 2 and edge count = 0. Confirms isolated nodes render without edges, satisfying the 'node count, edge count = 0' evidence criterion.

assertions.title: Five-node linear chain renders top-to-bottom
assertions.notes: No test asserts monotonically increasing X (or Y) coordinates for nodes in a linear dependency chain. Existing specs render up to 6 nodes but do not verify layout ordering in LR or TB direction.

assertions.title: Graph bounds match computed size
assertions.notes: No test asserts that all nodes are within the viewport bounds after fitView. Tests render nodes via getByTestId/visible, which only requires intersection with viewport, not that every node is within computed graph bounds.

assertions.title: Layout is stable across render cycles
assertions.notes: No test captures node X/Y coordinates before and after a hover/filter toggle and asserts identical (+/- 2px) positions. Existing tests verify counts, not positional stability.

assertions.title: Open issue node background is correct color
test_names: open node has data-status attribute
open node has full opacity
open node has normal styling (no filter)
assertions.notes: issue-node-styling.spec.ts:213-244 verifies data-status='open', opacity=1, and filter=none. The data-status attribute drives the CSS background-color var(--color-status-open), so this constitutes full coverage of the visual style claim.

assertions.title: In-progress issue node is colored distinctly
test_names: in progress node has data-status attribute
in progress node has full opacity
in progress node has solid border
assertions.notes: issue-node-styling.spec.ts:179-209 verifies data-status='in_progress', opacity=1, solid border. Combined with closed/deferred tests asserting different filter/border attributes, visual distinctness is covered via the attribute-driven styling contract.

assertions.title: Blocked issue node background indicates blocked state
test_names: blocked node has data-status attribute
blocked node has full opacity
blocked node has solid border
assertions.notes: issue-node-styling.spec.ts:248-279 verifies data-status='blocked' which selects the blocked color variable in CSS; opacity=1 and solid border confirmed.

assertions.title: Closed issue node background is dimmed/grayed
test_names: closed node has data-status attribute
closed node has reduced opacity
closed node has grayscale filter
closed node has solid border-top
assertions.notes: issue-node-styling.spec.ts:95-140 verifies data-status='closed', opacity≈0.6, grayscale filter present, solid border-top. The grayscale filter + reduced opacity fully encode the 'dimmed/grayed' visual claim.

assertions.title: Deferred issue node background is distinct
test_names: deferred node has data-status attribute
deferred node has reduced opacity
deferred node has dashed border
assertions.notes: issue-node-styling.spec.ts:144-175 verifies data-status='deferred', opacity≈0.7, dashed border — distinct visual treatment from open/in_progress/closed statuses.

assertions.title: Node displays formatted issue ID
assertions.notes: Helper getIssueNode(page, title) in issue-node-styling.spec.ts locates nodes by title text; nodes are verified to exist and be visible, but no test explicitly asserts the formatted issue ID string (e.g., 'LOOM-123') renders in node DOM.

assertions.title: Node displays truncated title if long
assertions.notes: No test asserts text-overflow: ellipsis or fixed-width truncation on node titles. Mock issue titles are short enough to not trigger truncation.

assertions.title: Node displays issue type badge
assertions.notes: No test asserts the presence of an issue type badge element inside a node. issue-node-styling tests focus on status styling, not type badges.

assertions.title: Node displays priority level (0-4)
assertions.notes: No test asserts that a node renders 'P0'..'P4' text or a priority indicator. Mock issues set priority=2 but no assertion checks the rendered output.

assertions.title: Node displays dependency count icons
assertions.notes: No test asserts incoming/outgoing dependency count icons render in the node footer.

assertions.title: Edge paths follow smooth step routing
test_names: 'blocks' type edge has dashed stroke pattern
'related' type edge has solid stroke (no dash)
blocking and non-blocking edges have different CSS classes
assertions.notes: dependency-edge-styling.spec.ts:232-299 verifies that edge-path elements render with correct stroke dasharrays and CSS classes, which implies React Flow's configured smoothstep edge type is being exercised. However, no test inspects the SVG path 'd' attribute for the L/curve segments characteristic of smooth-step routing, so the routing-shape evidence criterion is only partially met.

assertions.title: Clicking node triggers onNodeClick callback
test_names: closed node is clickable despite reduced opacity
deferred node is clickable despite reduced opacity
assertions.notes: issue-node-styling.spec.ts:282-323 clicks styled nodes and verifies they remain visible (pointer-events not disabled). No assertion that an onNodeClick callback fires or that a selection/detail-panel state change occurs.

assertions.title: Clicking canvas background deselects node
assertions.notes: No test clicks on the canvas background to verify node deselection. Selected-state assertions in issue-node-styling.spec.ts are .skip'd.

assertions.title: Hovering over node sets tooltip position
assertions.notes: No test asserts tooltip rendering or positioning on node hover.

assertions.title: Hovering over node invokes onNodeMouseEnter
assertions.notes: No test verifies onNodeMouseEnter callback fires or tooltip state changes on hover.

assertions.title: Mouse leaving node invokes onNodeMouseLeave
assertions.notes: No test verifies tooltip is cleared or onNodeMouseLeave fires when mouse exits a node.

assertions.title: Click-and-drag pans the viewport
assertions.notes: No test performs a click-drag on the canvas and asserts that the react-flow__viewport transform value changes.

assertions.title: Panning does not select nodes
assertions.notes: No test verifies that dragging to pan does not leave any node in selected state.

assertions.title: Double-click on node does not trigger selection twice
assertions.notes: No test asserts idempotent selected-state on double-click. Selection state tests in issue-node-styling are skipped.

assertions.title: Fit-to-view button brings all nodes in viewport
test_names: graph updates layout after toggle change
assertions.notes: show-closed-toggle.spec.ts:431 verifies graph updates layout (node counts) after toggle change, which implicitly triggers a re-fit. No test explicitly clicks the fit-to-view control or asserts that all node coordinates are within computed viewport bounds.

assertions.title: Mouse wheel zoom in
assertions.notes: No test dispatches a mouse wheel event and asserts the viewport scale transform increases.

assertions.title: Mouse wheel zoom out
assertions.notes: No test dispatches a mouse wheel event in the zoom-out direction and asserts the viewport scale transform decreases.

assertions.title: Zoom is bounded (min 0.1, max 2.0)
assertions.notes: No test verifies that repeated zoom-in/zoom-out actions clamp scale to the [0.1, 2.0] range.

assertions.title: Zoom respects fitViewOptions padding
assertions.notes: No test asserts that outermost nodes are not flush with viewport edges after fitView (padding margin > 0).

assertions.title: GraphControls widget is visible
test_names: status filter dropdown renders in GraphControls
assertions.notes: graph-status-filter.spec.ts:93 asserts page.getByTestId('graph-controls') is visible alongside the status filter. Confirms the controls panel mounts and contains filter and zoom-adjacent UI.

assertions.title: Status filter 'All' shows all issues
test_names: default filter is 'All' showing all issues
all issues visible when filter is 'all'
assertions.notes: graph-status-filter.spec.ts:142-165 asserts default filter value 'all' with 5 visible nodes, and separately verifies each data-status value is present exactly once under the 'all' filter.

assertions.title: Status filter persists to scoped localStorage
test_names: filter state persists to localStorage
assertions.notes: graph-status-filter.spec.ts:445 selects 'blocked' from dropdown and asserts localStorage.getItem('graph-status-filter') === 'blocked'.

assertions.title: Status filter restores from localStorage on load
test_names: filter state restores from localStorage
filter state persists across page refresh
assertions.notes: graph-status-filter.spec.ts:460-505 uses addInitScript to pre-seed localStorage, then asserts the dropdown reflects the saved value and the correct subset of nodes renders.

assertions.title: Show Closed toggle state persists to localStorage
test_names: toggle state persists to localStorage
toggle state restores from localStorage on page load
toggle state persists across navigation
assertions.notes: show-closed-toggle.spec.ts:340-427 covers full persistence lifecycle: writing to localStorage on change, restoring on page load, and preserving across view navigation (kanban ↔ graph).

assertions.title: Dependency type filter 'Non-blocking' controls non-blocking edges
test_names: non-blocking edges hidden by default
default shows Blocking and Parent-Child checked
checking Non-blocking shows non-blocking edges
assertions.notes: dependency-type-filter.spec.ts:195-325 verifies non-blocking checkbox is unchecked by default, that related-type edges are hidden when unchecked, and that checking the box reveals non-blocking edges.

assertions.title: Dependency type filter persists to localStorage
test_names: filter state persists to localStorage
filter state restores from localStorage
filter state persists across page load
invalid localStorage value falls back to defaults
assertions.notes: dependency-type-filter.spec.ts:468-548 verifies JSON array persisted under 'graph-dep-type-filter' key, restored on load, and falls back to defaults on invalid JSON.

assertions.title: Highlight Ready toggle enables ready-node highlighting
test_names: status filter works with Highlight Ready toggle
assertions.notes: graph-status-filter.spec.ts:556 enables highlight-ready toggle and asserts GraphView element has data-highlight-ready='true' attribute set.

assertions.title: MiniMap reflects viewport window
assertions.notes: No test asserts the MiniMap viewport mask/frame is visible or moves in response to pan/zoom.

assertions.title: Legend button is visible
assertions.notes: No test asserts visibility of the Legend toggle button.

assertions.title: Legend expands to show content
assertions.notes: No test clicks the Legend button and verifies the Priority/Status/Edges sections become visible.

assertions.title: Legend shows priority levels (P0-P4)
assertions.notes: No test verifies the Legend renders 5 priority items (P0..P4) with color swatches.

assertions.title: Legend shows status colors
assertions.notes: No test verifies the Legend renders status color swatches matching the rendered graph nodes.

assertions.title: Legend shows edge types
assertions.notes: No test verifies the Legend renders edge type examples (blocking, parent-child, related).

assertions.title: Legend shows indicators (Root Blocker, Blocked Count)
assertions.notes: No test verifies Root Blocker or Blocked Count legend items are rendered.

assertions.title: Legend collapses to hide content
assertions.notes: No test clicks the Legend a second time to verify its content is hidden.

assertions.title: Legend state is separate from filter controls
assertions.notes: No test asserts that toggling the Legend leaves node/edge counts unchanged.

assertions.title: SSE issue.created adds new node to graph
test_names: new dependency edge appears in graph after adding dependency
assertions.notes: integration/dependency-graph.integration.spec.ts:263 exercises the SSE pipeline for the graph view but for dependency.created (edge count increases), not issue.created (node count increases). Both issues in the test are created before the graph loads. No Playwright test creates an issue via API while the graph is open and asserts a new node appears via SSE. The SSE subscription path is partially exercised but this specific scenario is not.

assertions.title: SSE updates respect active filters
test_names: closing issue updates node styling in graph
assertions.notes: graph-status-filter.spec.ts verifies status filters remove non-matching nodes; dependency-graph.integration.spec.ts:294 verifies a closed node's data-status updates via SSE. No test verifies that an SSE-arrived issue whose status does not match the active filter is excluded from the visible graph.

assertions.title: Isolated node renders
test_names: graph with no dependencies renders no edges
assertions.notes: dependency-edge-styling.spec.ts:433 verifies two isolated nodes (no dependencies) render with 0 edges — directly demonstrates the isolated-node rendering claim.

assertions.title: Very long issue title (200+ chars) is truncated
assertions.notes: No test seeds an issue with a 200+ character title to verify truncation within node bounds. All mock titles are short.

assertions.title: Selecting/dragging during pan causes no errors
assertions.notes: No test combines pan and select interactions or captures console errors during concurrent interactions.

assertions.title: Graph renders in mobile viewport (360px width)
assertions.notes: No test sets viewport to 360x800 and asserts graph + controls are accessible. All existing specs use default desktop viewport.

assertions.title: Rapid filter toggling does not cause flicker
test_names: filter can be toggled repeatedly
assertions.notes: dependency-type-filter.spec.ts:614 toggles Blocking checkbox 3 times verifying correct edge counts after each state. Does not perform 5+ rapid toggles or verify absence of visual flicker.

assertions.title: Issue with undefined priority renders with default
assertions.notes: All mock issues used by spec files set priority=2 explicitly. No test exercises an issue where priority is omitted to verify the default/fallback rendering path (e.g., P4 or P2 default).

assertions.title: Issue with missing title renders 'Untitled'
assertions.notes: No test seeds an issue with an empty/missing title to verify the 'Untitled' placeholder fallback.

assertions.title: Empty graph does not render orphaned controls/legend
test_names: filter works with empty issues list
assertions.notes: graph-status-filter.spec.ts:610 mocks an empty issues response and asserts the status filter dropdown still renders and is interactive — confirms controls remain functional with 0 nodes.
